title: Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "forbidden tracking areas for  regional provision of service"

entities.name: Forbidden TAI(s)
entities.description: Indicates the forbidden TAI(s) to be stored in the list of forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service. This IE is included only when the message is sent via satellite E-UTRAN access.

entities.name: List of forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service
entities.description: A stored list containing tracking areas that are forbidden for regional service provision.

entities.name: Satellite E-UTRAN access condition
entities.description: Condition that the message is sent via satellite E-UTRAN access.

relations.description: The Forbidden TAI(s) IE indicates which tracking areas should be stored in the forbidden list for regional service.
The inclusion of the Forbidden TAI(s) IE is conditional upon the message being sent via satellite E-UTRAN access.
